key_events: Rhea traveled from Crater Ridge to the Ash-Choked Forest.
She stowed her Obsidian Shard in her left blazer pocket.
She discovered and harvested an Ash-Fungus.
The System charged her 85 Stamina as a Gathering Tax.
Rhea suffered extreme physical exhaustion, dropping to 15/100 Stamina.
Rhea tried to gather firewood in the Ash-Choked Forest.
The System charged her Stamina for picking up minor debris.
Rhea's Stamina hit 0, applying the Exhaustion status.
A System warning alerted her that stamina deficits would draw from HP, threatening instant death.
Rhea stopped gathering entirely and sat motionless to survive.
Rhea observed an ash-crusted scavenger knock a branch loose from a petrified tree.
She noted the absence of a System Gathering Tax on the physical collision.
Rhea deduced that the physics engine could be exploited to bypass the System's rigged economy.
She planned to herd the mob into a natural deadfall trap to crush it and harvest untaxed resources.
Rhea stowed her Ash-Fungus to free her hand.
She managed her Stamina regeneration tick by tick to avoid fatal HP drain.
She lured a scavenger into a deadfall trap using a thrown stone.
She used her Makeshift Masonry Bludgeon to trigger the deadfall without triggering a combat exertion penalty.
The scavenger was crushed, granting 15 XP.
The resulting dropped loot was untaxed by the System.
Rhea manually mashed the scavenger's dropped fungus with her bludgeon.
She successfully bypassed the System's 5 Stamina refinement fee.
She consumed the untaxed paste, restoring 24 HP and 40 Stamina.
Her Exhaustion status effect was removed.
Rhea approached an automated System deposit node and dumped her untaxed scavenger materials into the hopper.
The Deposit Interface attempted to apply a 5 Stamina tax and garnish the entire 4 Copper Credit yield toward her Soul Debt.
Rhea bypassed the default classification by finding a hidden sub-menu and selecting 'Environmental Debris Clearance'.
The reclassification reduced the tax to 0 Stamina and exempted the yield from garnishment.
Rhea successfully banked 4 Copper Credits, securing her first untaxed capital.
